test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 21 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In India, documented by a study, in which level of education is the majority of the population unemployed?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Graduate and post-graduate**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• India has a unique unemployment trend where **graduates and post-graduates face higher unemployment rates** compared to individuals with lower educational qualifications.
 
• The primary reason is a **mismatch between the skills acquired through higher education and the demands of the job market**.
 
• According to the Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS) 2022-23, the unemployment rate for highly educated individuals is significantly higher than for those with basic or vocational skills.
 
• The **lack of industry-relevant courses** and limited job opportunities in specialized sectors contribute to this trend.
 
• In contrast, those with primary or middle school education often take up **low-skilled jobs in the informal sector**, leading to lower unemployment rates in those categories.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Unemployment Rate in India**

 
 
• The unemployment rate is defined as the percentage of the labor force that is unemployed but actively seeking employment.
 
• The **PLFS** provides annual and quarterly estimates of employment and unemployment in India.
 
• India's overall unemployment rate was reported at **4.1% in 2022-23**, with significant variations across education levels.
 
 
 
• **Types of Unemployment in India**
 
 
• **Structural Unemployment:** Caused by a mismatch between job skills and market demands.
 
• **Frictional Unemployment:** Temporary unemployment during job transitions.
 
• **Disguised Unemployment:** Common in agriculture, where more people are employed than needed.
 
 
 
• **Government Initiatives to Address Unemployment**
 
 
• **Skill India:** Aims to train over 40 crore individuals in industry-relevant skills by 2022.
 
• **Startup India:** Promotes entrepreneurship by providing funding, mentorship, and tax benefits.
 
• **Atmanirbhar Bharat:** Focuses on self-reliance and job creation in various sectors.
 
 
 
• **Impact of Unemployment**
 
 
• High unemployment among educated individuals can lead to **economic inefficiency** and social unrest.
 
• It also contributes to **brain drain**, as skilled individuals seek opportunities abroad.
